from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class DocumentRecord(BaseModel):
    """Captures the title of a single judgment document and its assigned case categories."""
    title: str = Field(description="The document's title as provided (e.g., '《判决文书1》')")
    case_types: list[Literal['民事案件', '管辖案件', '行政案件', '赔偿案件', '执行案件', '刑事案件']] = Field(description="The list of case categories this document belongs to, based on its legal nature and procedure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentRecord]
